real_life_notes: One of Karachi's most notorious crime lords. Born in Lyari. Presided over the People's Aman Committee (PAC) — a gang masquerading as a community peace group. Killed in a police encounter in 2009. Film name is IDENTICAL to the real name, unusual for a Bollywood production.
objective: Consolidate criminal empire in Lyari; gain political legitimacy via Jamali and the Pakistani Awami Party; exploit FICN (Fake Indian Currency Note) networks with ISI patronage
film_relevance_note: Rehman is the primary target of Film 1. His ISI-linked FICN network and Jamali political cover are what Hamza must expose. His 2009 real-world death is incorporated into Film 1's climax — the oracle treats his elimination as a mission outcome node in the causal DAG.
loss_aversion_note: High λ=2.8: Dakait overweights territorial losses relative to gains. He will escalate violently when his Lyari control is threatened even if the expected-value case for restraint is clear.
